description:
Assuming you can actually find an Intel Arc B570 - and then find one at its supposed $220 MSRP - well, then you have one of the best value GPUs money can buy... but does the performance differential change when benchmarked in combination with a budget CPU? The answer is yes, meaning Intel's graphics cards do need more capable CPUs vs the competition in CPU-heavy areas. It's enough to make us rethink how we should tackle future budget GPU reviews...
